project_type: PHP 8 + MySQL backend (api/*.php) with a vanilla-JS ES-module frontend (js/, js/pages/). INR-denominated Bitcoin-tracking index unit called ARV. No build step, no framework, deployed on Hostinger shared hosting.
language: PHP 8.4 (backend), ES2015 JavaScript modules (frontend). No TypeScript, no bundler.
build_system: None. Files are served as-is. Charts use lightweight-charts 4.2.3 via CDN. Icons built with tools/build-icons.mjs (node), not part of runtime.
test_framework: None present. No unit tests, no CI workflows in the repo. Verification is by `php -l` syntax checks and manual reasoning only.
build_command: No build. Syntax-check PHP with: for f in api/*.php *.php; do php -l "$f"; done
test_command: No automated tests. Frontend JS can be sanity-checked with `node --check js/pages/<file>.js` (ES module syntax) where the file has no import-only-at-runtime concerns; note node --check does not resolve imports.
verification_instructions: 1) `php -l` every changed PHP file (must report 'No syntax errors detected'). 2) `node --check` every changed .js file for parse errors. 3) For arv-config.js, run `node -e "globalThis.window={};require('./arv-config.js');console.log(JSON.stringify(globalThis.ARV_CONFIG.CHARTS))"` style checks to confirm the config object still parses and has expected shape. 4) Reason through money-path invariants by hand. No live DB or exchange API is available in this sandbox, so ingest/backfill/matching cannot be executed end to end.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. The chart history (arv_candles, asset_candles) is generated at runtime by the cron/web-tick worker against live exchange APIs and stored in MySQL; it is NOT in the repo and cannot be regenerated in this sandbox.
setup_instructions: Production: create MySQL DB, deploy, open install.php, add one cron line (curl .../api/cron.php?job=all every minute). See SETUP.md. Not reproducible in this sandbox (no MySQL, no mail).
environment_constraints: PHP 8.4 CLI is available for `php -l`. Node 22 is available for `node --check`. NO MySQL server and NO mail server in the sandbox, so runtime behaviour (ingest, backfill, matching, migrations, the price feed) CANNOT be executed or verified here. Network access to exchange APIs from the sandbox is not assumed. All runtime verification must be deferred to a live environment and called out explicitly.
contribution_requirements: Preserve the money invariants documented in README.md and the file headers: integer paise for rupees, DECIMAL(28,8)/units-times-1e8 for units, NO floats on the money path, append-only ledger (enforced by MySQL triggers), every fill settles at the index price, issuance cannot move price, stale feed pauses trading. Settings defaults in api/_schema.php do NOT update an already-installed DB; live installs need a settings migration (see arv_migrations() in _schema.php, gated on ARV_SCHEMA_VERSION). Keep the silver-on-black design, existing CSS classes in css/core.css, and reveal animations.
key_patterns: NAV = index_price() in api/_money.php: base * (btcNow*fxNow)/(btcLaunch*fxLaunch). Units are derived from NAV via paise_to_u8(paise, nav) = floor(paise/100 / nav * 1e8) and valued via u8_to_paise(units8, nav). Cost basis is stored in paise (immutable) in wallets.invested_paise and lots.cost_paise; avgCostNav and unrealised P&L are DERIVED from invested_paise and current NAV. Candles are served from api/market.php action=candles reading arv_candles; the frontend charts call api.candles(tf, days, limit). The live tick feed lives in js/feed.js (WebSocket trades channel) and currently powers only the nav ticker and the trade tape - the CANDLE CHARTS in trade.js and dashboard.js do NOT consume it, they load static server candles and only re-poll snapshot every 30s. Config lives in arv-config.js (client copy) mirrored by arv_default_settings() in _schema.php (server source of truth).
relevant_files: arv-config.js (INDEX section ~line 81: arvBaseInr, launchIso, launchMs, baseUsd; CHARTS section ~line 335: timeframes, defaultTimeframe, ranges, backfill, maxCandles; BASKET/WATCHLIST for asset lists)

api/_schema.php (arv_default_settings() ~line 470+ for arv_base_inr/launch_at/base_btc_usd/auto_backfill_next; arv_migrations() ~line 690+ for the settings/units migration pattern; ARV_SCHEMA_VERSION const ~line 34; asset_candles + arv_candles + wallets + lots table defs)

api/_feed.php (ingest_prices() hardcodes foreach(['ETH','SOL']); backfill_tf() with allowed tfs and the `$sec < $launch` clamp ~line 168; fetch_candles_range() Coinbase/OKX paging; auto_backfill_after() chain; auto_backfill_floor(); rollup_all())
api/_money.php (index_price() ~line 136; paise_to_u8/u8_to_paise ~line 60-67; wallet_public() ~line 551 for the wallet object the UI consumes; arv_nav/arv_nav_meta)
api/market.php (handle_snapshot builds index{base,launchAt,...}; handle_candles reads arv_candles and clamps from launch; handle_watchlist hardcodes BTC/ETH/SOL; add per-asset candle serving here)
js/feed.js (live trades feed; allAssets()=BASKET+WATCHLIST; onTick/onTrade/candles(); handleTrade only appends to tape for BASKET assets)
js/pages/trade.js (chart via api.candles; daysFor(tf) map; buildTfTabs; st.tf=CFG.CHARTS.defaultTimeframe; NO live candle update wiring - st.feed declared unused)
js/pages/dashboard.js (Wallet page; buildRangeTabs uses CFG.CHARTS.ranges; loadChart via api.candles; paintWhatIf 'if you sold everything now'; wallet/P&L cards)
js/ui.js (NAV array ~line 142 with Wallet->dashboard.html; footer link list ~line 241)
dashboard.html (Wallet page markup: wallet-split, P&L grid g-4, chart-shell, orders, activity, whatif, watchlist)
css/core.css (all styling; reuse existing classes: card, stat, chart-shell, ledger-row, wallet-split, grid g-4, chip, badge, etc.)
directory_structure: Repo root has the HTML pages (one per screen) + arv-config.js + sw.js + manifest. api/ holds PHP endpoints and _prefixed shared includes (_boot, _money, _match, _schema, _feed). js/ holds shared modules (api, ui, feed, reveal, qr) and js/pages/ holds one module per HTML page. css/core.css is the single stylesheet. No tests, no CI.
